Hi so I've been thinking a lot lately about my life and I wanted to ask you something. I'm 35 and I've been in the same job for eight years and honestly I don't know if I'm staying because it's right or because I'm scared. My partner and I have been together five years and we keep having the same fight about whether to move cities. My mother is unwell and I feel guilty every time I think about leaving. I keep making lists and never acting on them. I read somewhere that my Saturn return was supposed to sort all this out but I turned 30 and nothing happened, or maybe it did and I didn't notice. Anyway what I really want to know is whether there's something in me that makes this so hard, or whether everyone feels like this and I'm just bad at being an adult. Sorry this is long.
